summary: PIM Manager now only ever removes access it manages itself.

fixes.title: PIM Manager removes only what it manages
fixes.text: A full reconcile with removal now removes only items PIM Manager manages. Everything else is reported as unmanaged and left alone.

fixes.title: Hand-assigned Entra roles are left alone
fixes.text: A role someone assigned by hand to the same user is no longer read, so it can never be removed.

fixes.title: Workload removals are applied
fixes.text: Deleted app role, Defender XDR and Intune rows are now applied, and app roles no longer show as new on every run.

fixes.title: Offboarding touches only PIM Manager groups
fixes.text: Offboarding removes an admin only from groups PIM Manager manages. Other memberships are reported, not removed.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Group retirement refuses a name that several live groups share, and a Defender XDR or Intune assignment shared with others is never deleted.
